impact: The PreCompact hook runs `zug compact`, which prints a checkpoint (stats + Active Patterns) to stdout expecting it to be injected as post-compaction context. Per the Claude Code hooks docs (verified 2026-05-28), PreCompact stdout is NOT added to the model's context — only SessionStart stdout is. So the printed checkpoint is dead: the model never sees it. No functional loss today because post-compaction reload is actually handled by the separate SessionStart/`compact` → `zug resume` hook (SessionStart stdout IS injected). Net effect: `zug compact`'s output is redundant/misleading dead code, and the PreCompact hook currently does nothing useful. T-043 repurposes PreCompact for a durability push (`zug push`); this issue tracks cleaning up or removing the ineffective print so the codebase doesn't imply a context-injection that never happens.
title: PreCompact hook checkpoint (zug compact) never reaches the model — stdout not injected
